_about: Pinned, verified sources for step P1 (Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 multi-angle). Sizes and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS metadata) and GitHub, read 2026-11-25. All model licenses: apache-2.0 per the official HF cards (see docs/OPEN_MODEL_EVALUATION.md §9.2).

driver.why: ComfyUI v0.46.0 Windows portable ships PyTorch built for CUDA 13.0; CUDA 13.x needs driver >= 580 (NVIDIA CUDA 13.5 release notes, Table 3).
driver.recommended: NVIDIA RTX Enterprise Production Branch R580 U12 (582.99), released 2026-10-21 (nvidia.com driver listing)

comfyui.sha256_source: GitHub release API asset 'digest', read on the owner's machine at install time

workflow_template.name: template_qwen_multiangle.app
workflow_template.title: Generate Multiple Angles with 3D Camera Node
workflow_template.note: Native nodes only (CameraAngle, TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus…). It links the text encoder from Comfy-Org/HunyuanVideo_1.5_repackaged; we use the byte-identical file from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image (apache-2.0).
